text:
ana: Quick proposal 1: new compact setup checklist anchored under the header (not a modal). Tight progress pill + a small sample projects carousel to the right. Goal: reduce interruption but still surface quickstarts. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.in/compact-checklist.png toan: Sounds promising. Concern: will users miss the CTA if it's too subtle? How do we communicate remaining effort? ana: (typo) ana: We'll surface "2 steps left 5 min" in the pill to set expectations. Primary CTA is "Finish setup 2 steps". Secondary is a text link "Use demo data". kim: UX nit: "2 steps left" should be localized-friendly (some langs put numbers differently). Also screen readers need a clear announcement: aria-live="polite" with a meaningful label like "Setup progress: 1 of 3". leah: Carousel accessibility: make sample cards focusable, add visible focus ring, and add "aria-roledescription=\"carousel\"" plus next/prev buttons with aria-controls. Also keyboard users should be able to tab into the carousel and arrow through cards. toan: Telemetry plan: instrument `setup_checklist_impression`, `setup_checklist_cta_click` with `cta: finish|demo`, and `sample_carousel_interaction` with `card_id`. We'll track variant: `compact|full` for experiment. ana: (again typo) ana: Copy options to A/B test: A) "Finish setup 2 steps" B) "Complete quick setup". Leaning toward A for explicit step count. kim: Contrast check: the sample card action text on the current mock is 3.1:1. We should push to 4.5:1 or use bold 600 weight for small caps. Also ensure the progress pill text is >=4.5:1 against its bg. leah: Keyboard flow: when a user finishes a checklist step, focus should move to the next actionable element (either next step or the primary CTA). Hitting ESC should collapse the rail (not page-level escape) and send `setup_checklist_action` with action=collapse. ana: Decision for MVP: anchored compact rail below header, show once per workspace session until completed or dismissed; pill shows steps left and estimated minutes; primary CTA copy = "Finish setup 2 steps"; sample carousel enabled with visible focus ring and prev/next buttons; telemetry events as Toan suggested; experiment flag `onboard_compact_v1`. toan: I'll create the tracking spec and add variant info. Also add a `dismiss_persistent` flag if user checks "Don't show this again". kim: Quick aria snippet for devs: ```
Setup progress: 1 of 3 (2 steps left, ~5 min)
Sample card A
``` leah: Also add `aria-live=\"assertive\"` for error messaging only (e.g., if the demo data import fails). We should keep the progress announcement polite to avoid interrupting screenreader users. design-bot: Note: feature flag `onboard_compact_v1` created. Draft Figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-checklist ana: (typo fixed) ana: Thanks! Next steps: Toan to add telemetry spec, Kim to push contrast updates in Figma, Leah to write keyboard/focus acceptance tests. We'll sync tomorrow morning if everyone can review the PR by EOD today.
